title: The double: four looks, the same man each time
subtitle: Edits of one night frame, so the room and the camera are identical. His skin and clothes keep their own colours; only the light is mint.

cells.label: A
cells.text: lantern: lit from inside the chest, thinning to mist at hands and feet

cells.label: B
cells.text: threads: fine threads of light still join him to the sleeper

cells.label: C
cells.text: frosted glass: almost solid, and the room catches his glow

cells.label: D
cells.text: woven light: his body drawn in fine flowing lines
